title: Nvidia Beat-and-Raise Fails To Bolster Markets, as the 4 Major Indices Fall Beneath Their 200-Day: Nov. 18, 2026
summary: A beat-and-raise quarter from semiconductor behemoth Nvidia is failing to bolster markets, as the firm’s decision to back away from Beijing sparks worries that future prospects in the sector will be weaker amidst slower transaction momentum from Asia.
